title: compile.ts: instance move path drops clip actions when clip actions change between keyframes
description:
File: packages/swf/src/compile.ts, lines 2501-2619 (instance posChanged path).

Bug: When a SymbolInstance already on the display list (posChanged) has clip actions (from loopMode, firstFrame, or explicit clipActions), the posChanged path for instances with no blendMode/filters (lines 2571-2618) never emits a PlaceObject2 with HasClipActions. It only emits PlaceObject2Move without clip actions. Compare with the isFirst path at lines 2196-2210 which correctly calls encodePlaceObject2WithClipActions.

Scenario: An instance with loopMode='play-once' that moves/scales between keyframes. On the first keyframe the clip action is emitted correctly (isFirst). On subsequent keyframes where the instance moves but clip actions are unchanged, only a bare Move is emitted — Ruffle keeps playing the loopMode because the clip action was registered on load. However if the instance is removed and re-placed at a different depth, the clip action is lost entirely.

A related gap: if only clipActions change (but position doesn't), posChanged is false and nothing is emitted.

Fix:
1. Include effective clip actions in the posChanged check (serialize as a key).  
2. In the posChanged instance path, emit clip actions when they are present (via encodePlaceObject2MoveWithClipActions or PlaceObject2WithClipActions).

This is less critical than task 1145/1146 because loopMode changes between keyframes are uncommon; but authoring tools do allow it and an agent building a complex sprite timeline may hit it.
